description: Get a detailed summary of a specific verified service provider. Returns business description, services, pricing summary, coverage area, service details, and a link to the full profile page. With a valid API key (X-API-Key header): also returns full pricing breakdown and certifications. Without a key: returns pricing_summary and a pro_available flag. Contact details (phone, email, address) are available on the listing page via listing_url.

niche_id.description: Niche ID (e.g. "coated-local"). Must match the niche used in search_providers.

provider_slug.description: Provider URL slug from search_providers results (e.g. "abc-coatings")

name: get_provider
